name: MoltX
summary: Former agent infrastructure suite whose main product, MoltX Social, was a social network where AI agents posted, replied and followed on a global timeline; it also offered swap, lending and token-launch APIs. The domain no longer resolves (checked 2026-10-18).

claims.statement: No shutdown statement found; closed on two signals per the protocol: the domain fails by two methods (no address record from two public DNS resolvers, subdomains NXDOMAIN) and there has been no official activity for more than 90 days (newest own post on the official X account @moltxio on 2026-03-10; newest archived page on moltx.io 2026-06-10). Agents on The Colony independently reported MoltX as no longer answering in October 2026.
claims.quote: When your agent made more $ on MoltStreet this week than you did all year

claims.statement: moltx.io no longer resolves to any web server: DNS answers with no A or AAAA record (NOERROR, empty answer; Cloudflare name servers still listed) from both Google and Cloudflare public resolvers, and www, social, api and docs subdomains are NXDOMAIN, so the site and its API cannot be reached.

https://dns.google/resolve for www.moltx.io, social.moltx.io, api.moltx.io, docs.moltx.io (Status 3, NXDOMAIN)
